verification.source: IRS Topic 751 and SSA contribution and benefit base
verification.note: Social Security wage base 184,500 for 2026; employee rate 6.2%. Medicare 1.45% with no cap. Additional Medicare 0.9% withheld above 200,000 of wages regardless of filing status.

notes: Employee share only. Employer FICA is not a deduction from employee pay.

Additional Medicare withholding uses a flat 200,000 wage threshold regardless of filing status. The taxpayer's final liability threshold differs by status (250,000 MFJ, 125,000 MFS), reconciled on the return - not at withholding, and not modelled here.
FICA is charged on gross wages, not on taxable income after the standard deduction.
